map.description:
Map name: the level file `levels/<map>.json` of the mod (or of the
game), without extension. Example: `MyLevel`.

thumbnail.description:
Optional thumbnail: PNG file of the mod (path relative to the mod
folder, `/` separators).

title.description: Title shown in the Workshop level list.

ModType.description:
Type du mod : exactement les tags de la catégorie « Type » du Workshop
(configuration Steamworks du 19 novembre 2026).

oneOf.description: New levels, played from the Workshop entry of the level selection.

Only replaces textures, sounds or fonts (keeps achievements, timer
and progression).
Changes game data (settings tables, meshes, materials, levels…).

description: Description of a Deeper Still mod (file mod.json at the root of the mod folder).

id.description:
Unique identifier: lowercase letters, digits, `_`, `-`, `.`
(1 to 64 characters, starting with a letter or a digit).

levels.description:
Levels added by the mod (listed in the Workshop entry of the level
selection).

requires.description: Identifiers of other mods that must be active too.

type.description:
Workshop tag. The game checks it against the files really present:
an `Asset Replacement` mod that contains anything other than images,
sounds or fonts is treated as a `Gameplay Mod`.

version.description: Version of the mod, free text (example: `1.0.0`).

workshop_id.description:
Workshop item id, written by `--workshop-envoyer` after the first
upload. Do not edit.

title: mod.json
